threat_model.threat_source: AI systems; their use in aggregate
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: systemic failures that are unaligned with the interests of their users or of the economy or society as a whole; loss of control through gradual disempowerment; an eventual automation of decision making; a gradual process in which humans are no longer valuable economic actors or political decision makers
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: even when AI systems can be controlled by (or aligned with the intentions of) their individual users; their use in aggregate; competitive pressure to adopt AI systems; At the extreme
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: interests of their users or of the economy or society as a whole; humans as economic actors or political decision makers; decision making
